Audience: first-time Minnesota Class D applicants who will share highways with motorcycles and trucks and cross rail lines and work zones.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the lane splitting and filtering limits [A02], the truck no zones and stopping distances [A04] and the railroad crossing distances [A05] are Minnesota-specific numeric items likely on the written test.
Level: moderate; the main risk is swapping similar numbers (twenty-five and fifteen mph, twenty and two hundred feet, ten and one hundred feet).
Prerequisites: the passing and following rules in the traffic laws chapter and the first half of the sharing the road chapter.
